visual_goal: Show one ingestion path: every source enters Inlet, is attached to one vehicle key in Anchor, stored as facts with provenance, and turned into views by versioned rules that products show.
prompt: A left-to-right flow. Far left, four small stacked source boxes, top to bottom: a building with columns labeled 'Registers', a blueprint sheet labeled 'Build data', a shield document labeled 'Insurers', and a small dealer storefront labeled 'Dealer input'. One arrow from each of the four sources into a single funnel labeled 'Inlet'. One arrow from 'Inlet' to a large key icon labeled 'Anchor', with the arrow labeled 'VIN first'. One arrow from 'Anchor' to a stack of cards, each with a small stamp, labeled 'Facts'. One arrow from 'Facts' to a panel of three small gauges labeled 'Views', with the arrow labeled 'versioned rules'. One arrow from 'Views' to a screen showing a small report and a blank price tag with no symbol, labeled 'Products'. These eleven labels are the only words in the image. Each label appears exactly once, directly below its icon; never repeat a label above an icon.
alt: Registers, build data, insurers and dealer input flow into Inlet, are keyed VIN first to Anchor, stored as stamped facts, turned into views by versioned rules and shown in products.
